as_told.title: Loadmaster tech sergeant warned him not to talk

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who served in the US Air Force, says that in 2012 at Langley Air Force Base in Virginia he saw a triangle-shaped craft. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2026 that afterwards his tech sergeant, a middle-ranking supervisor who worked as a loadmaster loading cargo on aircraft, warned him: "Dylan, don't talk about this ever again. You have no idea what you got yourself into." Borland says the man clearly knew something, which would mean people on the base were aware of the craft and wanted it kept quiet.
